M08-AC01.statement: No wrong-target or duplicate insertion across the full race test matrix.
M08-AC01.evidence: tests/v2/insertion/test_insertion_races.py 13/13 post-review: changed target (identity fail routes to saved + clipboard offer, target content unchanged), changed selection (replacement invalidated; caret move inserts), delayed paste inside settle (confirmed after consumption, restore after) and beyond settle (ownership kept, late paste still the right text), two queued results (serialized op log publish→restore→publish→restore, order preserved), cancelled retry (no transaction, no clipboard op), terminal multiline guard incl. the context-absent case (review regression), pre-existing identical text never confirms and keeps ownership (review regression). Pipeline suite drives the app-switch race through the real coordinator.

M08-AC02.statement: A user copy during LocalFlow restoration remains intact.
M08-AC02.evidence: race suite: user copy during the ownership window (hook-anchored, deterministic post-review) → restore skipped (user_copy_won), user content intact at the end; rich-data case restores text/rtf/png as one item and discloses the file promise as unsupported rather than claiming it.

M08-AC03.statement: Posted-but-unobserved output is never counted as confirmed insertion.
M08-AC03.evidence: race suite: partial insertion → readback 'partial' → posted_unverified; pre-existing identical text → readback 'match_ambiguous' → posted_unverified, ownership kept (review regression). Attribution suite: unreadable surface → 'unavailable' → posted_unverified + envelope outcome_observation_unavailable (unreliable_target). confirmed requires a pre-write consistency read plus an owned-range readback equal to the inserted text; the clipboard is never read as proof (E10).

M08-AC04.statement: Stale undo/selection does not delete newer user edits; unsupported multiline shell insertion offers preview/copy.
M08-AC04.evidence: attribution suite: undo of a replacement restores exactly; an edit inside the owned range degrades undo to the clipboard offer (content unchanged); race suite: terminal + multiline → saved_not_inserted/multiline_terminal_unverified with the text on the clipboard — with and without a context snapshot (review regression: the guard classifies the live frontmost bundle when no snapshot carried a category); single-line terminal inserts; a certified surface would insert (CERTIFIED_BRACKETED_SURFACES empty pending the E10 terminal trial). No synthetic Return/Backspace exists in the package.

M08-AC05.statement: Reliable observed edits are retained with exact target/job/region attribution; unsupported surfaces report unavailable rather than capturing arbitrary typing.
M08-AC05.evidence: attribution suite 10/10: in-range edit → stop owned_range_edited with before/after artifacts carrying the exact job_id and range; typing outside the range re-anchors (±400 cp, deadline-bounded post-review) without attribution; selection movement is not an edit; stop reasons recorded (window_elapsed, focus_lost, field_changed, secure_field_transition, new_dictation, session_locked, target_read_failed); the session lock re-arms on wake (review regression — observation no longer dies permanently after the first sleep); uncertified surfaces never poll.

M08-AC06.statement: No-edit intervals and confirmed pastes never automatically create verified positive training labels.
M08-AC06.evidence: attribution suite: no-edit window → envelope outcome.correctness stays 'unreviewed', observation.no_edit_observed true, no preference anywhere; undo inference recorded only as weak undo_candidate; pipeline suite: confirmed insert envelope keeps correctness unreviewed.

steps: From Terminal.app (own mic + Accessibility grants; one instance at a time): cd /Users/danny/Documents/Tools/LocalFlow && ./run.sh

Switch apps immediately after PTT release: dictate, ⌘⇥ to another app before processing finishes — expect nothing inserted into the new app, the text left on the clipboard (one-action ⌘V), and a saved_not_inserted entry.
Copy an image (and separately rich text) while a dictation processes — expect the clipboard content intact after the insert completes.
Dictate, then manually edit inside the inserted text, then use Recovery → Undo Last Insertion — expect the edit preserved and the previous text offered on the clipboard, never deleted.
Two rapid dictations back to back — expect both texts in order with no duplicate and no interleaved clipboard corruption.
Dictate a multi-line command into Terminal — expect copy-only (no paste, no execution); a single-line command pastes.
Record steps, expected vs actual, and evidence (event log lines insertion.*).

benchmark_summary.harness: instrumented fixture target — no model, no live app, no real pasteboard
benchmark_summary.ui_thread_rule: submit() is the entire UI-side cost (0.002 ms measured while a 0.6 s settle transaction was in flight); the pre-M08 path slept 50 ms inline and posted a racing 0.6 s restore thread per paste. Post-review, undo/paste-again also run their bounded work on the queue thread.
benchmark_summary.residual_risks: documented in contracts/insertion.md (clipboard vulnerability window between publish and target read; restore check-then-write micro-window; delayed paste beyond settle on unobservable surfaces keeps ownership instead of restoring)

review_loop.reviewers: two parallel read-only reviewers (bug-hunting debugger DB1; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor CA1)
review_loop.verdict_before_addressing: Request Changes — 3 criticals after dedup, 10 warnings, 17 suggestions
criticals: CA1 (unique): the multi-line terminal guard was bypassed when the job carried no context snapshot — with context disabled or PTT identity failed, newline-carrying text pasted into a shell. FIXED: the service classifies the live frontmost bundle when no snapshot carried a category; regression test (context-absent terminal).

DB1 + CA1 (corroborated): the session-lock stop signal was a one-way latch — after the first sleep/fast-user-switch every observation window died at tick 0 with a false stop reason for the rest of the process. FIXED: note_session_unlocked re-arms on didWake_, observer window wrapped in try/finally; regression test (lock → instant session_locked stop → unlock → next window runs to window_elapsed).

DB1 (unique): the clipboard path confirmed off pre-existing content — dictating text identical to what already sat at the caret returned 'match' from the first poll (no pre-write read), falsely confirmed and restored while the paste might still be pending, letting a late paste insert the restored user clipboard. FIXED: the pre-write consistency read; an early match over identical pre-existing content is match_ambiguous — never confirms, never early-restores, ownership kept; regression test.
warnings_addressed: cancel landing mid-transaction now records the real outcome (insertion.cancelled_after_insert + envelope) instead of discarding evidence; the genuinely-refused case keeps the old path — regression test
observer close-callback race reconciled (a window that stops before the start callback is dispatched is finished inline) + try/finally so the row always closes

paste_again no longer blocks the caller on the transaction (bounded reconciliation only; the re-paste submits async, outcome repaste_submitted); undo_last runs its bounded AX work on the queue thread (menu action dispatches via callback)
AXFocusedWindow is resolved from the application element on the system host (it is an app-element attribute; the field-element query was inert in production)
an unreadable live field role degrades to unavailable (identity alone governs) instead of failing validation
the re-anchor scan is deadline-bounded inside the candidate loop (no 160 s worst-case tick on a degraded surface)
PASTE_SETTLE_SEC replaces the two re-literal 0.6s; the paste-again read cap is a named documented constant

contract drift fixed: insertion.service_unavailable and insertion.cancelled_after_insert added to the events list; the field-role unreadable rule, live-bundle guard classification, ambiguous readback and partial-restores semantics documented; restore TOCTOU micro-window added to Limitations
Store emits store.migration_backup_skipped when an armed migration would run without a backup dir (the pre-existing silent skip that bit the live v4 apply)
the user-copy race test anchors on the on_post_begin hook instead of a clock sleep (flake hardening)
suggestions_addressed: dead code removed (record.latest_insertion, result.SCHEMA_VERSION, service.last_result, the benchmark's unused observer)
fixture pasteboard data_for_type is first-match (matches NSPasteboard semantics) with a comment

the redundant partial predicate simplified; hosts' threading import normalized; benchmark tick section labeled an approximation; honest undo recovery values (none when no before-text); service-unavailable fallback keeps recovery audio
deferred: jobs table maps a failed insertion to saved_not_inserted (the jobs state machine has no insertion-failed terminal; the insertions row carries the distinction and the journal-kept policy is right) — deliberate, documented here
multi-item clipboards flatten to one item on restore (types disclosed via captured_types/restored_types/unsupported_types; per-item fidelity is cosmetic for restore purposes) — documented
paste_again's substring reconciliation is approximate by design (a short dictated phrase appearing anywhere counts as present) — documented in the contract
benchmark tick cost is an approximation of the dominant reads rather than one instrumented real tick — labeled in the artifact
